recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-25525 unless a future work group decision changes the Bundle.entry fullUrl invariant semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-25525 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for Bundle. It reported that Bundle.entry bdl-8 used a bare fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not() expression, so entries with no fullUrl could evaluate to an empty collection/false even though transaction and batch entries can omit fullUrl.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to HL7/fhir PR #1138. Its implementation commit 235cb1af4119d6a1da874a29b82889e183b71860, "Fix FHIR-25525", changed source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml from the bare contains expression to fullUrl.exists() implies fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not() on the R4B history path. The current source path later received the same expression through FHIR-36006 commit 79442526caf5645dc6e1b867d66befaa67fb87d5.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2020-01-20 recorded the work group response to FHIR-25525 as "Sounds correct" and asked whether to propagate the fix back to R4. The originating Zulip thread confirmed that empty collections are false in FHIRPath and that the original bdl-8 expression was in error. FHIR-36006 rediscovered the same Bundle invariant issue in 2022, was Published/Persuasive, and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 4a1235c58d0508ad4bc4fc50b93787bff76c73f9, so it was not decided again here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini lists Bundle as an active infrastructure resource with code bdl, and current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml already contains the guarded bdl-8 expression requested by FHIR-25525. A current source search found no remaining active bare fullUrl.contains('/_history/').not() XML invariant.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue rediscovered the same Bundle bdl-8 missing-fullUrl problem and applied the current master expression; it already has a separate combined-branch audit commit.
